name: Uluru
describe: A single enormous sandstone monolith standing alone on a flat red desert plain, its flanks grooved and burning in the sun.

name: Grand Canyon
describe: A colossal layered gorge cut a mile deep into red rock, receding in bands of orange and violet to a hazy horizon.

name: Salar de Uyuni
describe: An endless white salt flat, cracked into hexagons, so level that the sky reflects in a skin of water.

name: Giant's Causeway
describe: Thousands of interlocking hexagonal basalt columns stepping down into a cold grey sea.

name: Perito Moreno Glacier
describe: A vast glacier wall of blue-white ice calving into a lake, cracking and booming as blocks fall.

name: Mount Fuji
describe: A near-perfect snow-capped volcanic cone rising alone above low cloud and forest.

name: Iguazú Falls
describe: A horseshoe of hundreds of waterfalls pouring through dense jungle, the air white with spray and sound.

name: Zhangjiajie Pillars
describe: Hundreds of slender sandstone pillars hundreds of metres tall, forested at the top, rising out of mist.

name: Pamukkale Terraces
describe: White travertine terraces stepping down a hillside, each basin holding warm turquoise mineral water.

name: Antelope Canyon
describe: A narrow slot canyon of smooth wind-carved sandstone, glowing orange where light falls from a slit far above.

name: Sossusvlei Dunes
describe: Towering rust-orange sand dunes with knife-sharp crests, dead black trees on a white clay pan below.

name: Plitvice Lakes
describe: A staircase of turquoise lakes linked by hundreds of small waterfalls through thick green forest.

name: White Sands
describe: Dunes of pure white gypsum sand rolling to a mountain horizon, blinding under a hard blue sky.

name: Bryce Canyon
describe: An amphitheatre of thousands of orange rock spires, thin and fluted, packed together below a rim of pines.

name: Fingal's Cave
describe: A sea cave of black hexagonal basalt columns, waves booming and echoing inside the cathedral-like space.

name: Dead Sea Shore
query: Dead Sea shore salt coast photograph
describe: A still, heavy, intensely salt sea below sea level, its shore crusted with white salt formations.

name: Moeraki Boulders
describe: Enormous perfectly spherical grey boulders scattered along a flat beach, half buried in wet sand.

name: Hạ Long Bay
describe: Thousands of limestone karst towers rising straight out of jade-green water, draped in vegetation.

name: Santorini Cliffs
describe: White cube houses with blue domes stacked down a sheer volcanic cliff above a deep blue caldera.

name: Venice Canal
describe: A narrow water street between tall ochre buildings, boats moored to striped poles, water lapping at worn stone.

name: Great Pyramid of Giza
describe: A colossal stepped stone pyramid of pale limestone blocks rising from desert sand.

name: Machu Picchu
describe: Terraced stone ruins on a knife-edge ridge, green peaks dropping away into cloud on every side.

name: Roman Colosseum
describe: A vast ruined stone amphitheatre of tiered arches, its floor opened to reveal the passages beneath.

name: Taj Mahal
describe: A symmetrical white marble mausoleum with a great central dome and four minarets, mirrored in a long pool.

name: Angkor Wat
describe: A huge sandstone temple of stacked towers inside a moat, its walls carved end to end, jungle pressing in.

name: Petra
describe: An enormous classical facade carved straight into a rose-brown sandstone cliff, columns and an urn cut from the living rock.

name: Stonehenge
describe: A ring of enormous rough-cut standing stones with lintels across the top, alone on open grassland.

name: Chichén Itzá
describe: A stepped limestone pyramid with steep stairways on four sides, standing on a cleared plain of short grass.

name: Hagia Sophia
query: Hagia Sophia interior nave dome photograph
describe: A vast grey stone domed building with four tall minarets at its corners, rising above trees and low walls.

name: Sagrada Família
describe: An unfinished cathedral of tall honey-coloured spires encrusted with carving, cranes still standing against the towers.

name: Mont-Saint-Michel
describe: A steep island crowned by an abbey, stone streets spiralling up, surrounded by vast tidal sand flats.

name: Potala Palace
describe: A huge white and ochre fortress-palace stacked up a hillside in thin, cold mountain air.

name: Easter Island Moai
describe: A row of enormous carved stone heads with heavy brows standing on a grass platform above the ocean.

name: Times Square
describe: A canyon of skyscrapers plastered with enormous glowing screens, dense with people and traffic noise.

name: Shibuya Crossing
describe: A huge intersection where crowds flood across from every direction at once beneath lit advertising.

name: Burj Khalifa
describe: A needle-thin tower silhouetted against a burning orange sky at dusk, far taller than everything around it.

name: Golden Gate Bridge
query: Golden Gate Bridge tower fog photograph
describe: A long orange-red suspension bridge with two tall towers, cables sweeping down, fog rolling through.

name: Sydney Opera House
describe: Interlocking white shell roofs on a harbour point, tiled and curved like sails, water on three sides.

name: Eiffel Tower
describe: A tapering iron lattice tower of crossed girders, open to the sky through its structure.

name: Brooklyn Bridge
describe: A suspension bridge with two gothic stone arches and a web of steel cables above a wooden walkway.

name: Grand Central Terminal
describe: The great stone facade of a railway terminal at night, lit windows and a sculpted clock group above the arches, taxis streaming past below.

name: Hoover Dam
describe: A colossal concrete arch dam curving between bare rock walls, water far below on one side.

name: Pripyat Ferris Wheel
describe: A rusting yellow ferris wheel standing in an abandoned amusement park, trees pushing through the pavement.

name: Panama Canal Locks
query: Panama Canal Gatun locks ship photograph
describe: Enormous concrete lock chambers with steel gates, a ship lifted between walls as water floods in.

name: Bingham Canyon Mine
describe: A gigantic open-pit mine cut in concentric terraces a kilometre deep, trucks like specks on the benches.

name: Chicago Elevated Loop
query: Chicago Loop elevated railway street view
describe: A dense wall of tall buildings along a lakefront, glass and steel towers crowded shoulder to shoulder above flat open water.

name: Cape Point Lighthouse
describe: A white lighthouse on a high rocky headland, cliffs dropping to two oceans meeting below.

name: Neuschwanstein Castle
describe: A white fairy-tale castle with blue turrets on a wooded crag, alpine peaks and gorge behind it.
